resources.string: Locks the apps you chose during Digital detox.

libreGLIDE uses this service only for Digital detox: when an app comes to the foreground it reads its package name and, if it is one you locked, shows the lock screen. It cannot read the content of the screen, it does not record anything and nothing leaves the phone.
